documents.text: Bearer API key authentication protects document upload and chat endpoints. Health endpoints remain public.
The readyz readiness endpoint reports failure when the Postgres database is unavailable. The healthz endpoint remains a liveness signal.
Uploaded PDF content stays local. Structured logs exclude document text, embeddings, API keys and personal data.
